source.observed_pattern: A PIVOT query turns category values into aggregate result columns and leaves a NULL when a group has no row for one of the requested categories.
source.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as a sales-channel report using one SUM(CASE WHEN ...) expression per requested channel and GROUP BY region. The conditional aggregates preserve totals for repeated channel rows and NULL for absent region/channel combinations without relying on PIVOT or batch separators.

fixture_notes: North has repeated web and store sales, South has store and mobile sales but no web sales, and East has only web sales. Missing channel/region combinations must remain NULL in the wide report.
determinism_notes: All sales rows and channel labels are fixed; region ordering is explicit and no limits, clocks, randomness, or concurrent schedules are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE channel_sales (sale_id INT PRIMARY KEY, region_code VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, sales_channel VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, net_amount INT NOT NULL)

steps.sql: SELECT region_code, SUM(CASE WHEN sales_channel = 'web' THEN net_amount ELSE NULL END) AS web_total, SUM(CASE WHEN sales_channel = 'store' THEN net_amount ELSE NULL END) AS store_total, SUM(CASE WHEN sales_channel = 'mobile' THEN net_amount ELSE NULL END) AS mobile_total FROM channel_sales GROUP BY region_code ORDER BY region_code

checks.sql: SELECT sale_id, region_code, sales_channel, net_amount FROM channel_sales ORDER BY sale_id
